newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: Abu Dhabi to offer free zone shares in two months.
newsitem.headline: Abu Dhabi to offer free zone shares in two months.

text.p: Share ownership in Abu Dhabi's $3 billion trade zone to be built on the Gulf island of Saadiyat will be open to local and foreign investors within two months, the project's general manager said on Saturday.

"Subscription to the al-Saadiyat Free Zone Management and Operating Co will open within two months," Mohammad al-Hosani told reporters on the sidelines of the United Arab Emirates (UAE) Forex Association quarterly meeting.

"Subscription will be open to UAE citizens and foreigners, but trading will be restricted to centres and bourses designated by the free zone authority," he added without specifying the value of the issue or the level of foreign participation in the company's capital.
UAE media said earlier that Abu Dhabi will offer foreign investors up to 30 percent ownership in the free trade zone.

Abu Dhabi officials have said the new trade zone, east of Abu Dhabi city, will specialise in storage, transport and trading of commodities. The plan includes setting up trading floors and exchanges to deal in various stored goods.
"Al-Saadiyat Free Zone will be one of the most sophisticated financial centres in the area," Hosani said.
